objects.name: Bring a tent, I've got the coffee: Lessons from it-sa
objects.description: Thorsten may have had to camp out in Nuremberg to attend it-sa, but the real story is the initiative to add a formal IT Security apprenticeship program in Germany for the thousands of young hackers ready to join our side.
